name: plex-language-sync
description: Set preferred audio and subtitle languages per show; every new episode follows automatically. Watches Plex playback in real time. When you pick an audio or subtitle track on one episode, the same choice is applied to the rest of the show, for that Plex user. It also learns your audio-to-subtitle habits and applies them to brand new shows before you press play. Multi-user aware, no web UI, no open port: a single small container that talks to your Plex server.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent cache: learned language profiles, shared-user tokens and sync state

variables.name: Plex URL
variables.description: Full URL of your Plex Media Server including scheme and port, e.g. http://192.0.2.100:32400

variables.name: Plex Token
variables.description: Plex authentication token of the server administrator (Plex Web: Settings, XML view, myPlexAccessToken)

variables.name: Update level
variables.description: Scope of language propagation: show applies to all episodes of the show, season only to the current season

variables.name: Update strategy
variables.description: Which episodes to update: all updates every episode in scope, next only the episodes after the one being played

variables.name: Trigger on play
variables.description: React to playback events: playing an episode propagates its language settings

variables.name: Trigger on scan
variables.description: React to library scans: newly added or updated episodes get each user's recorded selection for the show

variables.name: Learn language profiles
variables.description: Learn audio-to-subtitle language pairs from playback and apply them to brand new shows with no watch history

variables.name: Subtitle match tier
variables.description: How far a subtitle substitution may reach when no exact language match exists: identical, same-language, other-script, intelligible or shared-literacy

variables.name: Deep scan interval
variables.description: Cadence of the deep-scan safety net as a Go duration (24h, 12h); off disables it

variables.name: Ignore labels
variables.description: Comma-separated Plex labels that exclude a show from language sync (exact, case-sensitive; setting this replaces the defaults)

variables.name: Ignore libraries
variables.description: Comma-separated Plex library names to exclude entirely (exact, case-sensitive)

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: Minimum log level: debug, info, warn or error; debug shows per-event skip reasons and stream-matching detail

variables.name: Plex CA certificate path
variables.description: Only for an https Plex URL with a self-signed or private-CA certificate: in-container path of the CA PEM file (add a matching path mapping)
